definitions.gloss: working hours; work hours; hours of duty
definitions.explanation: The period of time during which an employee is required or expected to work. Used in both formal labor regulations and everyday workplace conversation to refer to one's scheduled work hours.

examples.japanese: {勤務時間|きんむじかん}は{九時|くじ}から{五時|ごじ}までだ。
{勤務時間|きんむじかん}{中|ちゅう}はスマホを{使|つか}わないでください。
examples.english: Please do not use your smartphone during working hours.

examples.japanese: {勤務時間|きんむじかん}の{短縮|たんしゅく}が{働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく}の{一環|いっかん}として{進|すす}められている。
examples.english: Reduction of working hours is being promoted as part of work-style reform.

notes:
Compound of {勤務|きんむ} ('duty; service; work') and {時間|じかん} ('time; hours'). One of the most fundamental terms in Japanese workplace vocabulary. Japan's labor laws and the ongoing {働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく} ('work-style reform') initiative have made {勤務時間|きんむじかん} a frequently discussed topic.

USAGE:
- {勤務時間|きんむじかん}{外|がい} ('outside working hours') and {勤務時間|きんむじかん}{内|ない} ('within working hours') are common modifiers.
- In Japan, the standard legal {勤務時間|きんむじかん} is eight hours per day and forty hours per week.
- Often discussed alongside {残業|ざんぎょう} ('overtime') and {有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか} ('paid leave').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勤務時間|きんむじかん}を{守|まも}る: to observe working hours
- {勤務時間|きんむじかん}の{短縮|たんしゅく}: reduction of working hours
- {勤務時間|きんむじかん}{外|がい}: outside working hours
- {勤務時間|きんむじかん}{中|ちゅう}: during working hours

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {労働時間|ろうどうじかん}: labor hours — a more formal and legal term, often used in labor law and statistics
- {就業時間|しゅうぎょうじかん}: business hours — similar in meaning, sometimes used interchangeably; emphasizes the established schedule
- {営業時間|えいぎょうじかん}: business hours — refers to the hours a store or office is open to customers, not employee work hours
